aliases: STCF candidate area, Hefei Future Big Science City

coordinates.note: Area marker, not the STCF site: the project documents name only the Hefei 'Future Big Science City' and show three candidate sites under geological exploration (final site not selected). The point is the OpenStreetMap polygon of the Hefei Advanced Light Facility (HALF), which the project slides place in the same Future Big Science City next to the candidate sites; precision about 5 km.

name: Hefei Future Big Science City (STCF project area)
notes: Campus-grade area marker only; the STCF tunnel site is not selected (three candidate sites; geological exploration and microseismic testing under way, Zheng 2024). The accelerator and the facility therefore use this point as an approximate area marker.

summary.plain: The suburban district of Hefei, China, called the Future Big Science City, where the proposed Super Tau-Charm Facility would be built on a site of about one square kilometre. Three candidate sites are being surveyed; none has been chosen.
summary.technical: Hefei Future Big Science City (Hefei Comprehensive National Science Center), Anhui, China; STCF site of about 1 km² to be chosen among three candidates near the Hefei Advanced Light Facility. The Atlas point (31.963 N, 117.125 E) is the OSM polygon of HALF, an area marker of about 5 km precision.
